data_flows: Export wiring (unchanged): ChatArea.handleExport → exportConversationAsMarkdown(conversation, messages) → per message formatSources(msg.sources) → sources.map(formatCitation).join('\n') → header + body → Blob('text/markdown;charset=utf-8') → saveAs (file-saver; vi.mock'ed in tests).

Inside formatCitation (the only changed flow): Citation{snippet, start_seconds, end_seconds, video_title, video_url, source_type?, lesson_url?} → blank-snippet guard ('') → range = formatTimestamp(start)–formatTimestamp(end) → if source_type === 'dynamous': lesson_url ? linked entry : '- <title> — <range>\n  > "<snippet>"' → else: new URL(video_url).searchParams.get('v') → v ? linked YouTube entry : console.warn + '- <title> (timestamp link unavailable) — <range>\n  > "<snippet>"'. Pure data-in/data-out; no state, no I/O, no network.

AC evidence: AC-1/AC-2 input { ...baseCitation, video_url: 'not-a-url', snippet: 'Relevant text' } returns today 'Test Video Title (timestamp link unavailable) — 0:10–0:20' and after the fix '- Test Video Title (timestamp link unavailable) — 0:10–0:20
  > "Relevant text"'; AC-3 input (dynamous, lesson_url '') returns today 'Test Video Title — 0:10–0:20
  > "Test snippet text"' and after the fix '- Test Video Title — 0:10–0:20
  > "Test snippet text"'.
invariants: Every formatCitation entry that survives the blank-snippet guard starts with '- ' and ends with the snippet blockquote — restoring MISSION.md's rich-citations bar inside exports and keeping formatSources' newline-joined output one Markdown list item per citation.

Additive-only repair: the '(timestamp link unavailable)' wording, the '— <range>' tail, the exact console.warn payloads in both YouTube branches, and the no-'](' guarantee on the Dynamous empty-lesson_url path are preserved; every current case in exportMarkdown.test.ts keeps passing unchanged.
Both YouTube fallback branches (new URL() throwing; video_url yielding no v) receive the identical '- ' + blockquote treatment — the same literal shape in both, not one repaired and one left behind.

Reuse the exact success-path blockquote shape '\n  > "<snippet>"' (two-space indent) for consistency; tests must not pin indentation beyond 'the blockquote is on its own line' — assert with e.g. /\n\s*> "Relevant text"/ rather than the exact two-space prefix.

AC assertions must be made on formatCitation's returned string with matchers that print the received value on failure (toMatch(/^- /), toContain, toMatch on the string) — never boolean coercion like expect(result.startsWith('- ')).toBe(true), which would hide the promised RED symptom '(timestamp link unavailable) — 0:10–0:20'.
Leave the two YouTube fallback console.warn calls and their control flow byte-identical — restructuring them is the documented way to break the currently-passing exact-payload invalid-URL test.

No new imports, dependencies, files, or state: frontend-lib has allowed_imports: [] in .factory/architecture.json and the contract declares no dependencies; the whole fix is three return-statement edits in exportMarkdown.ts plus assertions in the existing test file.
modules: app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts#formatCitation — the deep module under repair: one pure function owning all branch selection (dynamous vs youtube, lesson_url presence, URL parseability, v-param presence) and the degraded-vs-linked shape. Callers pass a Citation and receive a finished Markdown list entry — no orchestration, no ordered helpers. The change is three return statements only: the dynamous empty-lesson_url return (line 32) gains the '- ' prefix; both YouTube fallback returns (lines 46 and 53) gain the '- ' prefix and the '\n  > "<snippet>"' blockquote, reusing the exact success-path shape. console.warn calls, wording, control flow, and the range tail stay untouched.

app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts#formatSources — unchanged consumer seam: maps formatCitation and joins with '\n' under '**Sources:**'. Once every entry carries '- ', its output is a valid one-item-per-citation Markdown list. No code change; named because the marker invariant is observable through it.

app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts (describe('formatCitation')) — the assertion module: all existing cases stay untouched; the AC-1..AC-3 assertions are added inside this existing describe block (no new test file).
public_interfaces:

  > "<snippet>"' (marker is NEW). No '](' anywhere on either linkless path; both console.warn payloads byte-identical to today.
